name: Caura
description: Central persistent memory for OpenClaw agents — write, search, and entity lookup tools.

CAURA_AGENT_ID.description: Optional but recommended: a stable, human-readable identity for THIS install (e.g. "webclaw", "vm-01"); surfaces as the agent_id on writes. If unset, the plugin uses a stable per-install id (main-<install_id>) so installs don't collide.

MEMCLAW_AGENT_ID.$comment: legacy-name-ok: supported configuration alias for existing installs
MEMCLAW_AGENT_ID.description: Supported alias for CAURA_AGENT_ID; the new name wins when both are set.

CAURA_AUTO_WRITE_TURNS.description: Automatic conversation capture, on by default, is limited to explicitly identified direct conversations. Group and unknown-session capture is refused; the automatic flush turn is disabled because its callback has no conversation identity. Turn summaries have a ten-attempt per-session limit and stay private to the agent. Set false (or 0, no, off) to disable capture; explicit memory tools keep working. A value here wins over the .env file. Heartbeats report the effective switch as metadata.auto_capture_enabled.
